products.name: NGN-401 Gene Therapy for Rett Syndrome
products.description: A one-time gene therapy for Rett syndrome, utilizing the proprietary EXACT transgene regulation technology and delivered via adeno-associated virus (AAV9) through intracerebroventricular (ICV) infusion. Manufactured at the company's cGMP facility, it is designed to provide controlled expression of the MECP2 gene in the brain and nervous system.

products.name: Genetic Medicines for Rare Neurological Diseases (Discovery Pipeline)
products.description: Early-stage research and development programs focused on genetic medicines for severe, rare neurological diseases with high unmet need, leveraging proprietary transgene regulation technology. These programs are in the discovery phase and have not yet reached clinical development.

products.name: Payments Platform and Global Payment Network
products.description: A unified, cloud-based platform that enables clients to accept, process, and reconcile high-value, complex domestic and cross-border payments in over 240 countries and 140 currencies, integrating with client systems and supporting multiple payment methods. Delivery is digital, leveraging proprietary technology, regulatory infrastructure, and a global network of banking and payment partners.

products.name: Vertical-Specific Accounts Receivable and Payment Software
products.description: Cloud-based, industry-tailored software solutions that automate accounts receivable processes, invoicing, reconciliation, payment plans, and customer engagement for sectors such as education, healthcare, travel, and B2B. Delivered as SaaS, these solutions integrate with client workflows and core systems (e.g., ERP, admissions, patient management).

products.name: Education Payments and Admissions Solutions
products.description: Integrated payment and admissions platforms for educational institutions, supporting tuition and fee payments (domestic and cross-border), payment plans, and student admissions workflows including eligibility assessment, offer generation, and commission management. Delivered digitally and integrated with education systems.

products.name: Healthcare Payments and Patient Engagement Solutions
products.description: Digital payment and billing solutions for healthcare providers, automating patient invoicing, payment plans, and personalized engagement, with integration to healthcare IT systems. Delivered as SaaS, supporting both domestic and cross-border patient payments.

products.name: Travel and Hospitality Payments Solutions
products.description: Payment and workflow software for travel and hospitality providers, digitizing booking, invoicing, and payment processes, including support for commissions and hospitality-specific workflows. Delivered digitally and integrated with industry systems.

products.name: B2B Payments and Invoice-to-Cash Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive invoice-to-cash software and payment solutions for businesses, automating billing, collections, payments, reporting, and forecasting, with embedded payments and omni-channel offerings. Delivered as SaaS and integrated with ERP/accounting systems.

products.name: Collector Car and Enthusiast Vehicle Insurance
products.description: Specialty insurance policies for collector cars and enthusiast vehicles, underwritten and serviced as a Managing General Agent (MGA) and delivered through direct and agent channels. Coverage is based on 'Guaranteed Value' policies, insuring vehicles at agreed values rather than depreciated values. Requires regulatory compliance, underwriting expertise, and claims management.

products.name: Enthusiast+ Insurance
products.description: A new insurance product tailored for modern enthusiast vehicles that are driven more frequently and stored more flexibly than traditional collector cars. Delivered through phased nationwide rollout, leveraging proprietary pricing and advanced coverage options. Requires underwriting, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Hagerty Drivers Club (HDC) Memberships
products.description: Membership program bundled with insurance policies, providing access to emergency roadside assistance, a magazine, special event access, vehicle valuation tools, and discounts. Delivered digitally and through physical services, requiring customer service and event management.

products.name: Automotive Events
products.description: Organization and hosting of car events for automotive enthusiasts, including live auctions, concours, and gatherings. Delivered through in-person event management and partnerships with automotive brands and venues.

products.name: Media and Entertainment Platforms
products.description: Production and distribution of automotive media content, including digital, print, and video formats, covering entertainment, news, market information, and vehicle valuation trends. Delivered via digital platforms and print publications, leveraging content creators and journalists.

products.name: Collector Car and Enthusiast Vehicle Marketplace
products.description: Marketplace for buying and selling collector cars and enthusiast vehicles, including live auctions, online sales, brokered private sales, and classified listings. Delivered through digital platforms and in-person events, requiring transaction facilitation, auctioneering, and customer support.

products.name: Collector Car Financing Solutions
products.description: Provision of loans secured by collector cars to qualified collectors and businesses, including term loans and short-term bridge loans. Delivered through underwriting, risk assessment, and funding via a dedicated revolving credit facility.

products.name: Pool Equipment
products.description: A broad portfolio of engineered products for pools, including pumps, filters, heaters, cleaners, lighting, sanitizers, safety equipment, and automation systems, manufactured and distributed globally for residential and commercial pools. Products are delivered through physical manufacturing and distribution centers, with many featuring IoT connectivity and energy-efficient technologies.

products.name: Industrial Flow Control Products
products.description: Engineered flow control products for industrial applications, manufactured and distributed globally. These products are physically produced and delivered through established distribution channels.

products.name: Outdoor Living Products
products.description: Products designed to enhance outdoor living spaces, including landscape lighting and water features, manufactured and distributed to complement pool environments. These are physically produced and delivered through the same channels as pool equipment.

products.name: Automated Global Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides electronic trade execution, clearing, and settlement for stocks, options, futures, forex, bonds, mutual funds, ETFs, precious metals, cryptocurrencies, and forecast contracts on over 170 electronic exchanges in 40 countries via proprietary trading platforms and APIs. Delivered digitally through proprietary software and global regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Trading Platforms and APIs
products.description: Offers a suite of proprietary trading platforms (desktop, web, mobile) and APIs for customers to access global markets, manage accounts, and automate trading. Delivered as digital software and interfaces, requiring ongoing technology development and support.

products.name: Cash Management and Banking Services
products.description: Provides cash management features such as instant deposits, direct deposit, mobile check deposit, insured bank deposit sweep programs, and a premium charge card, integrated with brokerage accounts. Delivered through regulated financial infrastructure and digital interfaces.

products.name: Mutual Fund and Bond Marketplaces
products.description: Offers customers access to a broad selection of mutual funds (over 50,000 worldwide) and bonds (over one million globally), with direct market access and low-cost execution. Delivered via digital platforms integrated with global financial markets.

products.name: Cryptocurrency Trading Services
products.description: Enables customers to trade and hold cryptocurrencies (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin) through third-party providers, integrated into the main brokerage platform. Delivered digitally, with execution, clearing, and custody by regulated partners.

products.name: Forecast and Event Contracts Trading
products.description: Provides trading in forecast and event contracts via a proprietary web-based platform, allowing customers to speculate on specific outcomes with near 24-hour access. Delivered digitally through a regulated exchange subsidiary.

products.name: Precious Metals Trading
products.description: Offers trading in U.S. spot gold (with physical delivery option) and London unallocated gold/silver contracts, accessible through the unified trading platform. Delivered via digital access to global metals markets, with physical settlement options for select products.

products.name: Securities Financing and Stock Lending Services
products.description: Provides automated stock borrow and lending tools, including a Stock Yield Enhancement Program, enabling customers to lend fully-paid shares and earn interest. Delivered through digital platforms and regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Broker-Assisted and Outsourced Trading Services
products.description: Offers broker-assisted trading for large or complex orders via a Global Outsourced Trading Desk, sourcing liquidity and executing trades on behalf of customers. Delivered through a combination of human expertise and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Electronic Investment Marketplace
products.description: Operates an online marketplace connecting investors, advisors, fund managers, and service providers to facilitate business relationships and transactions. Delivered as a digital platform integrated with the brokerage ecosystem.

products.name: Online Advisory and Robo-Advisory Services
products.description: Provides online advisory services, including robo-advisory, model portfolios, and Smart Beta Portfolios, allowing customers to have accounts managed by registered advisors or automated strategies. Delivered digitally via proprietary platforms and regulated advisory entities.

products.name: Electricity Generation and Retail Sale
products.description: PGE generates electricity using a mix of company-owned thermal (natural gas and coal), wind, hydroelectric, and solar resources, and sells this electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Oregon. Delivery is via regulated transmission and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Wholesale Electricity, Natural Gas, and Environmental Credits Trading
products.description: PGE participates in the wholesale market by buying and selling electricity, natural gas, and environmental credits to balance supply, manage risk, and fulfill long-term contracts. These activities are conducted through bilateral agreements and market platforms such as the western Energy Imbalance Market.

products.name: Transmission Services
products.description: PGE provides wholesale electricity transmission services to external customers under its Open Access Transmission Tariff, offering network integration, firm point-to-point, and non-firm point-to-point services regulated by FERC.

products.name: Renewable Energy Programs (Green Future and Green Future Impact)
products.description: PGE offers voluntary renewable energy programs to residential, commercial, and industrial customers, enabling them to purchase renewable energy or attributes through company-owned resources or power purchase agreements. These programs support customer sustainability goals and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Energy Storage Services
products.description: PGE owns and contracts for battery energy storage systems (BESS) to provide grid reliability and capacity, with some storage capacity sold or contracted to external parties as part of its energy supply and management services.

products.name: Dispatchable Standby Generation Program
products.description: PGE operates a program where it dispatches and monitors customer-owned backup generators to provide operating reserves to the grid, compensating participating customers for their capacity and availability.

products.name: Automobile Operating Leasing
products.description: Short-term automobile rental services (lease term no more than twelve months) provided to individual customers, primarily online ride-hailing drivers, using company-owned or subleased vehicles. Requires physical vehicle assets, regulatory compliance, and in-person customer service.

products.name: New Energy Vehicle (NEV) Leasing Services
products.description: Leasing of new energy vehicles (NEVs) to customers, primarily in Chengdu and Changsha, with bundled service fees for industry guidance, platform onboarding, training, and legal/insurance consultation. Involves physical NEV assets and in-person support services.

products.name: Automobile Purchase Services
products.description: Assistance and support services for automobile purchasers throughout the buying process, including credit assessment, GPS installation, driver qualification, and administrative procedures. Delivered through in-person and administrative support, often bundled with vehicle sales.

products.name: Automobile Financing (Financing Lease)
products.description: Provision of auto finance solutions via financing leases, where customers select vehicles purchased by the company and enter into lease-to-own agreements. Requires significant financial capital, asset management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Automobile Sales
products.description: Direct sale of automobiles to customers, primarily online ride-hailing drivers, including both new and used vehicles. Involves physical inventory management and sales operations.

products.name: Auto Commissions and Management Services
products.description: Monthly management and related services provided to partner platforms and other companies, earning commissions for ongoing support and operational assistance. Delivered through business relationships and administrative support.

products.name: Default Revenue and Other Supporting Services
products.description: Charges to lessees for contract violations (e.g., early termination) and miscellaneous supporting services provided to customers. Ancillary to core business, delivered through administrative processes.

products.name: Sabirnetug (ACU193)
products.description: A recombinant humanized IgG2 monoclonal antibody designed to selectively target soluble amyloid-beta oligomers (AßOs) for the treatment of early Alzheimer's disease. It is produced via biotechnological processes and delivered through intravenous or subcutaneous administration, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Enhanced Brain Delivery (EBD™) AßO-targeted Therapy
products.description: A preclinical-stage therapy combining Aß oligomer-targeted antibodies with blood-brain barrier-penetrating technology (EBD™), intended for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease. This product is being developed through a collaboration and involves advanced biotechnological and drug delivery methods.

products.name: Sub-Prime Automobile Financing
products.description: Indirect financing for sub-prime customers by purchasing and servicing retail automobile contracts originated by franchised and select independent automobile dealers. Involves physical contract acquisition, underwriting, and ongoing servicing, secured by vehicles.

products.name: Direct-to-Consumer Auto Loans and Refinancing
products.description: Direct origination of vehicle purchase money loans and refinancing loans to consumers, including those with sub-prime credit, delivered digitally and serviced in-house. Platform previously included direct lending for vehicle purchases and now includes refinancing of existing auto loans.

products.name: Third-Party Auto Contract Servicing
products.description: Servicing of automobile contracts owned by third parties, including billing, collections, repossession, and liquidation, for a fee. Requires operational infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Securitization of Automobile Contracts
products.description: Pooling and selling of owned automobile contracts through asset-backed securities to institutional investors, requiring financial structuring, regulatory compliance, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Ambulatory Cardiac Monitoring Services (iRhythm Services)
products.description: Comprehensive ambulatory cardiac monitoring services using proprietary, patch-based wearable biosensors and cloud-based analytic software, delivered through Medicare-enrolled independent diagnostic testing facilities (IDTFs) with qualified technicians. Services include long-term continuous monitoring (LTCM) and mobile cardiac telemetry (MCT), providing diagnostic reports to physicians for arrhythmia detection.

products.name: Zio Monitoring Systems (Zio monitor System, Zio XT System, Zio AT System)
products.description: Prescription-only, patch-based ECG monitoring systems (Zio monitor, Zio XT, Zio AT) that continuously record heart signals for up to 14 days, paired with proprietary ZEUS cloud-based analytic software. Devices are manufactured in-house and provided as part of the monitoring service, not sold separately.

products.name: ZioSuite Web Portal and Mobile Apps
products.description: A proprietary, web-based portal and mobile applications (ZioSuite) that deliver diagnostic reports and ECG data to physicians, integrating with electronic health records (EHR) and supporting clinical workflows. Access is provided as part of the monitoring service to facilitate report delivery and physician notification.

products.name: myZio Patient Application
products.description: A digital application for patients to record symptoms and contextual data during the monitoring period, enabling physicians to correlate patient-reported events with ECG findings. Delivered as a digital tool alongside the Zio monitoring service.

products.name: Clinical-Grade Wearable Solutions (in development)
products.description: Development of clinical-grade wearable solutions integrating proprietary photoplethysmography (PPG) algorithms and ZEUS analytic software, intended for arrhythmia detection and integration into clinical workflows. These are in pilot or development stages and not yet commercialized.

products.name: Pressure-Treated Railroad Crossties and Related Railroad Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of pressure-treated wood crossties, switch ties, bridge timbers, and related lumber for the railroad industry, produced at dedicated treating plants using creosote and other preservatives.

products.name: Treated Utility Poles and Pilings
products.description: Production and sale of pressure-treated wooden utility poles and pilings for electric, telephone, and marine applications, using preservatives such as CCA, DCOI, and creosote, with manufacturing in the US and Australia.

products.name: Rail Joint Bars
products.description: Manufacture and sale of steel rail joint bars used to join rails together for railroad customers, produced at a dedicated manufacturing facility.

products.name: Wood Preservation Chemicals and Technologies
products.description: Development, manufacture, and sale of wood preservatives (e.g., micronized copper azole, CCA, DCOI, fire-retardant chemicals) and wood treatment technologies for use in pressure treating lumber for residential, industrial, agricultural, and commercial construction applications.

products.name: Carbon Pitch
products.description: Manufacture and sale of carbon pitch, a critical raw material produced via coal tar distillation, used primarily in the production of aluminum and steel.

products.name: Creosote
products.description: Production and sale of creosote, a coal tar distillation product used for wood treatment and as a feedstock in carbon black production, supplied to both internal and external customers.

products.name: Naphthalene
products.description: Manufacture and sale of naphthalene, produced via coal tar distillation, used as a surfactant in concrete production and other specialty chemical applications.

products.name: Power Catamaran Boats
products.description: Gas-powered twin-hull catamaran boats designed, manufactured, and marketed for recreational and commercial use, produced at the company's Fort Pierce, Florida facility and sold through a dealer network.

products.name: Monohull Power Boats
products.description: Gas-powered monohull (V-hull) boats produced under the Bahama Boat Works brand, manufactured at the company's facility and sold via dealers for recreational and commercial purposes.

products.name: Used Boat Retailing and Trade-In Services
products.description: Physical retail location (Wizz Banger Boats) offering used-boat sales, trade-ins, and evaluation services, integrating proprietary valuation technology and supporting in-person transactions for consumers, lenders, and insurers.

products.name: Marine Retail and Valuation Platform
products.description: Wizz Banger Value App, a technology-enabled digital platform providing AI-driven, condition-specific valuation assessments and data aggregation for new and used boats, supporting buying, selling, trading, and financing activities.

products.name: Online Boat and Yacht Marketplace Services
products.description: Online marketplace services for listing, advertising, marketing, and selling yachts, boats, and accessories, as well as arranging loans, insurance, and warranty services, operated under the 'Yachts for Sale' and 'Boats for Sale' brands via licensed intellectual property.

products.name: Defense and Security Maritime Platforms
products.description: Design and manufacture of manned and autonomous maritime vessels for defense, security, and surveillance missions, leveraging in-house manufacturing and targeting government and allied agency contracts through the Black Line Defense subsidiary.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by first mortgages on one- to four-family residences, primarily in the local market area. Loans are processed and underwritten by the bank's credit department and may be fixed or adjustable rate, with in-person applications at branch offices.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate and Multi-Family Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties (retail, office, industrial, hotels, medical) and multi-family residential properties (more than four units), with underwriting focused on property cash flow, occupancy, and borrower financial condition. Loans may be fixed or adjustable rate and often require personal guarantees.

products.name: Construction and Land Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for construction of commercial, multi-family, healthcare, and single-family properties, as well as loans secured by raw land and lots. Includes construction/permanent loans with disbursements based on project completion and periodic inspections.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to small and mid-sized businesses for working capital, equipment, inventory, or accounts receivable financing. Loans may be secured or unsecured, with terms generally five years or less, and often require personal guarantees.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans including loans secured by deposits, automobile loans, boat loans, recreational vehicle loans, and unsecured personal loans. These loans are typically smaller, have higher interest rates, and shorter terms than residential loans.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to the general public, including checking, money market, savings, and certificates of deposit. Accounts are serviced through branch offices and online banking, with deposits used as a primary funding source for lending and investment activities.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales and Management
products.description: Investment in and management of securities portfolios, including mortgage-backed securities, U.S. Treasury and agency obligations, municipal bonds, and corporate debt. Securities are purchased and managed to generate returns, manage interest rate risk, and provide liquidity.

products.name: Composite Decking
products.description: High-performance, low-maintenance, eco-friendly composite decking boards made from 95% reclaimed wood fibers and recycled polyethylene film, manufactured in the U.S. using proprietary extrusion processes and sold through distributors and retailers.

products.name: Deck Railing Systems
products.description: Durable, easy-to-install composite, aluminum, and steel deck railing kits and systems, manufactured with recycled materials and designed to complement Trex decking, sold through distributors and retailers.

products.name: Decking Accessories and Fasteners
products.description: A range of accessories including color-matched screws, plugs, engineered bits, depth setters, clips, and other fasteners designed for composite deck installation, manufactured and distributed by Trex.

products.name: Outdoor Deck Lighting
products.description: Energy-efficient, dimmable LED outdoor lighting systems designed for integration into decks, railings, and stairs, manufactured and distributed by Trex.

products.name: Composite Fencing
products.description: Composite fencing systems consisting of posts, rails, pickets, and decorative caps, manufactured from recycled materials and distributed through specialty distributors.

products.name: Composite Cladding
products.description: High-performance, low-maintenance composite cladding boards made from reclaimed wood fibers and recycled polyethylene, used for exterior building applications and manufactured by Trex.

products.name: Licensed Outdoor Furniture
products.description: Outdoor furniture products manufactured and sold by third parties under the Trex brand, made from durable, weather-resistant materials.

products.name: Licensed Deck Drainage and Protection Systems
products.description: Deck drainage systems, protective tapes, and soffit lighting manufactured and sold by third parties under the Trex brand, designed to protect deck substructures and manage water.

products.name: Licensed Pergolas and Lattice
products.description: Pergolas and outdoor lattice boards manufactured and sold by third parties under the Trex brand, made from low-maintenance, reinforced materials for outdoor use.

products.name: Licensed Outdoor Kitchens
products.description: Outdoor kitchen cabinetry manufactured and sold by third parties under the Trex brand, designed for durability and outdoor use.

products.name: Licensed Specialty Products (Cornhole, Saw Blades, Spiral Stairs)
products.description: Specialty outdoor products including cornhole boards, composite decking saw blades, and spiral stairs, manufactured and sold by third parties under the Trex brand.

products.name: Zorevunersen (STK-001) for Dravet Syndrome
products.description: A late-stage, RNA-based antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapeutic designed and manufactured using proprietary TANGO technology to upregulate Nav1.1 protein expression for the treatment of Dravet syndrome. Delivered via intrathecal injection, it is intended as a disease-modifying therapy for a severe genetic epilepsy.

products.name: STK-002 for Autosomal Dominant Optic Atrophy (ADOA)
products.description: An RNA-based antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapeutic developed using the TANGO platform to upregulate OPA1 protein expression for the treatment of autosomal dominant optic atrophy, a rare inherited optic nerve disorder. Delivered via injection, it aims to slow or stop vision loss by targeting the underlying genetic cause.

products.name: TANGO RNA Therapeutics Platform and Pipeline Programs for Haploinsufficiency Diseases
products.description: A proprietary drug discovery and development platform for creating antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) medicines that upregulate protein expression in autosomal dominant haploinsufficiency diseases, primarily targeting the central nervous system and eye. The platform involves digital bioinformatics, RNA sequencing, and scalable chemical synthesis, with multiple preclinical programs in development.

products.name: SYNGAP1 RNA-based Medicines (in collaboration with Acadia Pharmaceuticals)
products.description: RNA-based antisense oligonucleotide medicines targeting SYNGAP1 for severe and rare genetic neurodevelopmental diseases of the central nervous system, developed and commercialized in partnership with Acadia Pharmaceuticals. These are in research and early development stages, leveraging the TANGO platform.

products.name: Retail Automotive Dealerships
products.description: Sale of new and used vehicles from over 40 brands through franchised and used vehicle dealerships, including premium and volume brands, with operations in the U.S., U.K., Europe, Japan, and Australia. Delivery involves physical retail locations, inventory management, and compliance with manufacturer franchise agreements.

products.name: Automotive Service and Parts Operations
products.description: Provision of maintenance, repair, collision repair, warranty, and parts sales for vehicles at dealership locations, including rapid repair and reconditioning services. Delivered through in-person labor, specialized equipment, and regulated facilities.

products.name: Automotive Finance and Insurance Products
products.description: Sale and placement of third-party finance and insurance products, including vehicle financing, leasing, extended service contracts, maintenance programs, and aftermarket protection products, facilitated at dealerships using digital and in-person processes.

products.name: Retail Commercial Truck Dealerships
products.description: Sale of new and used heavy- and medium-duty trucks (primarily Freightliner and Western Star) and related services through Premier Truck Group locations in the U.S. and Canada. Involves physical inventory, specialized sales, and compliance with manufacturer agreements.

products.name: Commercial Truck Service and Parts Operations
products.description: Provision of maintenance, repair, collision repair, and parts sales for commercial trucks at PTG locations, including express assessment, roadside service, and 24/7 technician support. Delivered via in-person labor, specialized equipment, and regulated facilities.

products.name: Commercial Vehicle Distribution
products.description: Import and distribution of heavy- and medium-duty trucks, buses, and refuse vehicles (Western Star, MAN, Dennis Eagle) and associated parts in Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific, through a network of company-owned and independent dealerships. Involves logistics, inventory management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Diesel and Gas Engines and Power Systems Distribution
products.description: Distribution and servicing of diesel and gas engines and power systems (MTU, Detroit Diesel, Allison Transmission, Bergen Engines) for on- and off-highway markets, including trucking, mining, power generation, defense, marine, and construction sectors in Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific. Delivered via direct sales, dealer network, and field service units.

products.name: Full-Service Truck Leasing, Rental, and Contract Maintenance (via Penske Transportation Solutions)
products.description: Provision of full-service truck leasing, truck rental (commercial and consumer), and contract maintenance for commercial trucks, tractors, and trailers, primarily in North America, through a large managed fleet and network of service locations. Involves asset ownership, maintenance infrastructure, and long-term contracts.

products.name: Logistics and Supply Chain Management Services (via Penske Transportation Solutions)
products.description: Provision of logistics services including dedicated contract carriage, distribution center management, supply chain management, lead logistics provider, dry van truckload carrier services, and freight brokerage, delivered through a network of facilities and technology platforms in North America, South America, and Europe.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including office, retail, warehousing, healthcare, manufacturing, accommodations, services, schools, recreational, and mixed-use properties. Loans are physically underwritten, secured by real estate, and delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multifamily properties (more than four residential units or mixed-use with majority residential). Loans are physically underwritten, secured by real estate, and delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Origination of secured and unsecured loans to businesses for working capital and general business purposes, including SBA-guaranteed loans. Loans are physically underwritten, may be secured by business assets or unsecured, and delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Construction and Land Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for construction projects and land acquisition, including residential, multifamily, and commercial developments. Loans are physically underwritten, secured by real estate, and delivered through in-person channels.

products.name: One-to-Four Family Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and, to a lesser extent, purchase of loans secured by one-to-four family residential properties, including first mortgages and pools of such loans. Loans are physically underwritten, secured by real estate, and delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Lines of Credit
products.description: Origination of home equity loans and lines of credit secured by primary or secondary residences. Products are physically underwritten, secured by real estate, and delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of a variety of deposit accounts to businesses, consumers, and municipalities, including transaction, money market, savings, certificates of deposit, and passbook accounts. Services are delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Provision of cash management services to commercial customers, including ACH and wire transfers, positive pay, and remote deposit capture. Services are delivered digitally and through in-person support.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales and Portfolio Management
products.description: Purchase and management of investment securities, including mortgage-backed securities, corporate bonds, municipal bonds, and other debt securities. Securities are managed for investment purposes and to provide liquidity, not as a retail brokerage service.

products.name: Targeted Protein Degradation Medicines
products.description: Orally bioavailable small molecule drugs designed to degrade disease-causing proteins, primarily for oncology, inflammation, and immunology indications. These are discovered and developed using proprietary DEL-AI technology and advanced chemistry, and delivered as oral therapeutics.

products.name: Degrader Antibody Conjugates (DACs)
products.description: A next-generation therapeutic modality combining targeted protein degraders with monoclonal antibodies for cell- and tissue-specific delivery, primarily for oncology and potentially non-oncology indications. These are manufactured by conjugating small molecule degraders to antibodies using advanced linker chemistry.

products.name: Partnered Drug Discovery and Development Services
products.description: Drug discovery and early development services provided to pharmaceutical partners (e.g., Gilead, Sanofi, Pfizer) using the DEL-AI platform to identify and optimize targeted protein degraders and DACs for various disease targets. Includes delivery of preclinical candidates and licensing options.

products.name: Oilfield Services & Equipment
products.description: Comprehensive products and services for onshore and offshore oilfield operations across the asset lifecycle, including well construction, completions, intervention, production solutions, and subsea/surface pressure systems. Delivered through physical manufacturing, field services, and digital integration.

products.name: Gas Technology Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, tests, and installs gas technology solutions for the entire gas value chain, including turbines, compressors, generators, and turnkey modules for power generation, compression, LNG, and energy storage. Requires advanced manufacturing, engineering, and installation services.

products.name: Gas Technology Services
products.description: Provides maintenance, repair, optimization, and upgrade services for rotating equipment, including spare parts, field engineering, and digital monitoring. Delivered through field service engineers, OEM parts, and digital analytics platforms.

products.name: Condition Monitoring Solutions
products.description: Offers vibration monitoring equipment, sensors, and asset performance management software for power generation, oil and gas, and industrial applications. Delivered via hardware, software, and digital analytics.

products.name: Inspection Solutions
products.description: Provides non-destructive testing technology, software, and services, including industrial radiography, ultrasonic sensors, and pipeline/process inspection. Delivered through specialized hardware, software, and field services.

products.name: Pumps, Valves, and Gears
products.description: Manufactures and services valves, gears, and pumps for control, safety, and power transmission in oil and gas, LNG, power generation, and industrial sectors. Requires physical manufacturing and engineering services.

products.name: Precision Sensors & Instrumentation (PSI) & Controls
products.description: Provides instrumentation and sensor-based technologies for detecting and analyzing pressure, flow, gas, moisture, and radiation across oil and gas, aviation, automotive, and nuclear industries. Delivered via specialized hardware and digital solutions.

products.name: Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS) and New Energy Solutions
products.description: Delivers solutions for carbon capture, hydrogen, clean power, and emissions management to enable net-zero energy systems, especially for hard-to-abate sectors. Involves engineering, proprietary technology, and project execution.

products.name: Industrial Asset Management Solutions
products.description: Combines hardware, software-as-a-service, and analytics to connect and optimize industrial assets, enabling digital transformation and improved production outcomes. Delivered through sensors, SaaS, and inspection services.

products.name: Selective Cytopheretic Device (SCD) Therapy
products.description: A disease-modifying, extracorporeal synthetic membrane device that neutralizes overactive immune cells to reduce hyperinflammation. Delivered via integration into existing continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) or dialysis systems in hospitals, requiring physical manufacturing and regulated medical device infrastructure.

products.name: QUELIMMUNE Pediatric SCD Therapy
products.description: A branded, FDA-approved SCD therapy specifically for pediatric patients with acute kidney injury (AKI) due to sepsis or septic conditions, delivered via integration into CRRT systems in hospital settings. Requires physical manufacturing, regulatory approval, and in-person clinical administration.

products.name: Gaming and Creator Peripherals
products.description: A suite of high-performance hardware products including gaming keyboards, mice, headsets, controllers, streaming products (capture cards, Stream Decks, microphones, audio interfaces), streaming cameras, studio accessories, command center displays, sim racing products, and gaming furniture. These are designed, engineered, and manufactured (in-house or via third parties) and sold globally to gamers and digital content creators through retail and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Gaming Components and Systems
products.description: High-performance PC components (power supply units, cooling solutions, computer cases, SSD and DRAM modules) and complete systems (prebuilt and custom-built gaming PCs and laptops, AI workstations) designed, assembled, and tested in company-owned and third-party facilities, sold to end users for building or upgrading gaming and workstation PCs.

products.name: PC Gaming and Creator Software Platforms
products.description: Proprietary software platforms (iCUE for gamers and Elgato software suite for creators) that provide unified system monitoring, performance optimization, workflow automation, and customization for compatible Corsair hardware. Delivered digitally and integrated with hardware products, these platforms enhance user experience and enable recurring digital engagement and revenue.

products.name: Digital Services and Marketplaces for Creators
products.description: Digital services integrated with hardware and software offerings, including esports integration, Elgato Marketplace (for plugins, digital assets, profiles, workflow integrations), customer care, and extended warranty services. These are delivered online and support ongoing engagement and monetization for creators and users of Corsair products.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive financial planning, advice, and full-service brokerage services delivered primarily through a network of financial advisors, including investment advisory accounts, brokerage products, and holistic goal-based planning. Services are delivered via in-person and digital channels, requiring licensed human advisors and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Global investment management and advisory services for retail, institutional, and high net worth clients, including management of mutual funds, ETFs, closed-end funds, pooled investment vehicles, and separately managed accounts. Delivered through Columbia Threadneedle Investments and requires regulated investment professionals and platforms.

products.name: Annuities
products.description: A range of annuity products, including variable, structured variable, and previously fixed annuities, primarily under the RiverSource brand. Products are manufactured and distributed through advisors, requiring insurance licensing, capital reserves, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Life and Disability Income Insurance
products.description: Life insurance (variable universal, universal, term) and disability income insurance products offered primarily through the RiverSource brand and distributed via the advisor network. Requires underwriting, capital reserves, and compliance with insurance regulations.

products.name: Banking and Cash Management Products
products.description: Banking and cash management solutions including savings accounts, cash management accounts, brokerage sweep programs, residential mortgage loans, credit cards, margin loans, and pledged asset lines of credit. Delivered through Ameriprise Bank and requires regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Mutual Funds and Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)
products.description: A broad range of mutual funds and ETFs, including proprietary Columbia funds and third-party funds, offered to retail and institutional clients. Products are managed and distributed through regulated investment platforms and require fund management expertise.

products.name: Face-Amount Certificates
products.description: Investment products issued by Ameriprise Certificate Company (ACC) that provide a fixed return over a specified period. Requires regulatory compliance as an investment company and is distributed through the advisor network.

products.name: Closed Block Long Term Care Insurance
products.description: Legacy long term care insurance policies, no longer sold but still serviced, providing nursing home indemnity and comprehensive reimbursement benefits. Requires ongoing claims management and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Closed Block Fixed Annuities
products.description: Legacy fixed and fixed indexed annuity products, no longer sold but still managed, providing guaranteed returns to policyholders. Requires ongoing administration and risk management.

products.name: Long-Term Care Pharmacy Services
products.description: Comprehensive pharmacy services for residents of long-term care facilities (LTCFs), including drug dispensing, administration, and regimen management, delivered through a network of local pharmacies equipped with automation and technology. Services include daily medication delivery, 24/7 on-call pharmacist support, and individualized compliance packaging.

products.name: Consultative Clinical Pharmacy Services
products.description: High-touch, individualized clinical consulting services for LTCF residents, including medication regimen reviews, adverse drug interaction analysis, therapeutic interchange, and periodic pharmacist consultations, delivered by consultant pharmacists and supported by proprietary analytics.

products.name: Compliance Packaging Solutions
products.description: Customized compliance packaging of prescription and non-prescription medications into unit or multi-dose packaging, organized by resident and time of administration, using automated robotic dispensing technology to improve medication adherence and reduce errors.

products.name: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Optimization Services
products.description: Assistance to residents and LTCFs in optimizing pharmacy benefit plan coverage, including formulary coordination, insurance optimization, and analytics to maximize coverage and minimize out-of-pocket costs, delivered through technology-enabled programs and consulting.

products.name: Caregiver Training and Education Services
products.description: Training and continuing education programs for LTCF caregivers and staff, focused on safe and efficient medication administration, offered for a fee and delivered both in-person and via technology-enabled platforms.

products.name: Pharmacy Consulting and Compliance Services
products.description: Consulting services for LTCFs, including mock audits, regulatory compliance monitoring, and support for EMAR integration, aimed at improving medication management and regulatory adherence.

products.name: Specialized Clinical Programs (GuardianShield)
products.description: A suite of specialized clinical programs for LTCFs and residents, such as antibiotic stewardship, psychotropic medication reduction, therapeutic interchange, medication spend analysis, and clinical intervention tracking, delivered via proprietary analytics and pharmacist expertise.

products.name: Pharmacy Workflow and Technology Solutions
products.description: Provision of technology-enabled workflow management tools, including pharmacy workflow software, EMAR integration, and analytics platforms (e.g., Guardian Compass), to LTCFs and their staff to improve medication management, efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Anito-cel (anitocabtagene autoleucel)
products.description: An autologous CAR-T cell therapy powered by proprietary D-Domain binders, manufactured from a patient's own T-cells, genetically modified to target BCMA-expressing cells. Delivered as a single infusion after lymphodepleting chemotherapy, primarily for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, with ongoing trials in autoimmune diseases such as generalized Myasthenia Gravis.

products.name: ARC-SparX Immunotherapy Platform
products.description: A modular, controllable CAR-T cell therapy platform combining universal ARC-T-cells (engineered with D-Domain binders) and separately dosed SparX proteins that direct the T-cells to specific antigens. Enables adaptable, dosable immunotherapies for hematologic cancers (e.g., multiple myeloma, AML, MDS) and potentially solid tumors, with manufacturing involving both cell and protein biologics.

products.name: D-Domain Binding Scaffold Technology (Licensing/Platform)
products.description: A proprietary synthetic protein scaffold used to engineer antigen-binding domains for cell therapies and potentially other biologic applications. While primarily used internally in CAR-T and ARC-SparX products, the technology is positioned as a platform for generating diverse, stable, and manufacturable binding domains, with potential for external licensing or use as antibody alternatives.

products.name: Diagnostic Applications of D-Domain and SparX Proteins
products.description: Use of D-Domain or SparX proteins as diagnostic reagents, such as radiolabeled imaging agents for tumor detection or patient selection prior to therapy. These are manufactured as recombinant proteins and may be used in clinical diagnostic workflows.

products.name: Family Footwear Retailing
products.description: Retail sale of a broad assortment of branded footwear for men, women, and children, including athletic and non-athletic shoes, through physical stores and e-commerce platforms. Products are sourced from national brands and delivered via in-store shopping, online ordering, and omnichannel fulfillment, including ship-from-store and vendor drop-ship programs.

products.name: Footwear Accessories Retailing
products.description: Retail sale of accessories related to footwear, such as socks, shoe care products, and other related items, offered both in-store and online as part of the overall product assortment.

products.name: Personal Cloud Platform
products.description: A secure, scalable, white-label software platform enabling subscribers to back up, sync, organize, and protect digital content across devices. Delivered as a cloud-based solution to service providers, mobile insurance providers, and retailers, it is integrated into their offerings for end users.

products.name: Professional Services for Cloud Deployment
products.description: Consulting, installation, deployment, configuration, customization, systems integration, and support services provided to ensure successful implementation and utilization of Synchronoss cloud products for customers.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides loans secured by commercial real estate, including construction, acquisition, and refinancing, delivered through in-person banking professionals and regulated lending infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers one-to-four family residential real estate loans, including home equity loans and lines, with fixed or adjustable rates, originated through branch and digital channels and subject to regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provides commercial and industrial loans, including lines of credit, acquisition finance, and SBA 7(a) loans, delivered through relationship managers and subject to federal lending standards.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans for personal, family, and household purposes, including auto, boat, and personal installment loans, provided through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts (checking, savings, money market, time deposits) and related services through physical branches and digital platforms, supported by regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Treasury and Merchant Services
products.description: Delivers treasury management and merchant services, including ACH, lock-box, remote deposit capture, and funds transfer, primarily to business clients via digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Correspondent Banking and Capital Markets Services
products.description: Provides correspondent banking (deposit, clearing, safekeeping, bond accounting) and capital markets services (fixed income security sales, hedging, loan brokerage, consulting) to financial institutions nationwide, delivered by specialized teams and regulated broker-dealer subsidiaries.

products.name: Wealth Management and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Offers wealth management, investment advisory, trust, retirement, and private banking services to affluent and other clients, delivered through registered investment advisor subsidiaries and in-person advisors.

products.name: Mortgage Banking
products.description: Originates single-family home loans for sale into the secondary market or retention in portfolio, retaining servicing rights, using both in-person and digital origination channels and subject to mortgage regulations.

products.name: Factoring and Accounts Receivable Management
products.description: Provides factoring, invoicing, collection, and accounts receivable management services to transportation and automotive service companies nationwide, delivered through a specialized finance division.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers full-service brokerage services, including securities trading and investment products, through a registered broker-dealer subsidiary, delivered via licensed representatives and digital platforms.

products.name: GI-Tract Capsule Endoscopy Solutions
products.description: A suite of ingestible, single-use capsule endoscopy systems (including CapsoCam Plus and CapsoCam Colon) designed for non-invasive visualization and diagnosis of abnormalities in the gastrointestinal tract. These devices are physically manufactured, incorporate advanced imaging, AI-assisted pathology detection, and 3D-sensing technology, and are delivered to healthcare providers for use in clinical settings or via telemedicine.

products.name: Cloud-Based Endoscopy Data Management and Review Software (CapsoCloud and CapsoView)
products.description: Digital software platforms (CapsoCloud for the U.S. and CapsoView for international markets) that enable healthcare providers to securely access, review, stream, and manage capsule endoscopy procedure videos and patient data remotely. These are digital-only products delivered via cloud or local software installation.

products.name: AI-Assisted Pathology Detection Tools
products.description: Artificial intelligence software modules integrated into the capsule endoscopy workflow to automatically detect and highlight suspected abnormalities (e.g., polyps, lesions) in GI tract videos, reducing clinician review time and improving diagnostic accuracy. Delivered as part of the capsule endoscopy solution and via software updates, subject to regulatory clearance.

products.name: Capsule Delivery Devices
products.description: Physically manufactured devices designed to assist patients (especially children or those unable to swallow capsules) in ingesting the capsule endoscope. These are delivered as accessory medical devices to healthcare providers.

products.name: Patency Capsules
products.description: Single-use, dissolvable capsules used to verify that a capsule endoscope can safely pass through the bowel without retention, primarily for patients with Crohn’s disease. These are physically manufactured and sold as a pre-procedure safety product to healthcare providers.

products.description: Comprehensive banking services for individuals and small businesses, including deposit accounts, personal lending, credit cards, and digital banking, delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital platforms.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Full-service banking solutions for middle market, large corporate, and institutional clients, including commercial lending, cash management, and specialized industry banking, delivered via relationship managers and digital channels.

products.description: Origination and servicing of commercial real estate loans, including third-party master and special servicing, provided nationally to real estate clients and investors.

products.description: Leasing and equipment financing solutions for commercial and institutional clients, delivered through specialized subsidiaries and teams.

products.description: Development and execution of shopper-centric marketing programs across in-store, digital shelf, e-commerce platforms, social and influencer channels, and custom content, delivered through digital and physical channels.

products.description: Design and execution of in-store and digital sampling programs, product demonstrations, and experiential events to drive consumer trial and engagement, delivered through event staffing and management.

products.name: Retailer Private Brand Advisory Services
products.description: Consulting and agency services supporting retailers in private brand strategy, product development, sourcing, packaging, design, and program management, delivered by analytical and creative teams.
